crossRefs.note: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire…
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
“This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a…
Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives become…
We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.
“Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to…

parallels.note: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

translations.web: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
translations.bsb: My anger will be kindled, and I will kill you with the sword; then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless.
translations.kjv: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
translations.asv: and my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
